question: Where must a School Speed Limit assembly be placed, what advance sign is required, and how is the downstream end normally marked?
model_answer: Direct Answer: A School Speed Limit assembly (or School Speed Limit When Flashing S5-1 sign) must be placed at, or as near as practicable to, the point where the reduced school speed limit zone begins. A School (S1-1) sign is required in advance of the first School Speed Limit assembly or S5-1 sign encountered in each direction. The downstream end of the zone is normally marked with an END SCHOOL SPEED LIMIT (S5-3) sign (with an END SCHOOL ZONE (S5-2) sign permitted as an alternative under Paragraph 4 of Section 7B.05). Standards (mandatory): - "A School Speed Limit assembly (see Figure 7B-1) or a School Speed Limit When Flashing (S5-1) sign (see Figure 7B-1) shall be used to indicate the speed limit where a reduced school speed limit zone has been established based upon an engineering study or where a reduced school speed limit is specified for such areas by statute. The School Speed Limit assembly or School Speed Limit When Flashing sign shall be placed at or as near as practicable to the point where the reduced school speed limit zone begins (see Figures 7B-2 and 7B-4)." - "If a reduced school speed limit zone has been established, a School (S1-1) sign shall be installed in advance (see Table 2C-3 for advance placement guidelines) of the first School Speed Limit sign assembly or S5-1 sign that is encountered in each direction as traffic approaches the reduced school speed limit zone (see Figures 7B-2 and 7B-4)." - "Except as provided in Paragraph 4 of this Section, the downstream end of an authorized and posted reduced school speed limit zone shall be identified with an END SCHOOL SPEED LIMIT (S5-3) sign (see Figures 7B-1, 7B-2, and 7B-4)." - "At the downstream end of the section to which a particular speed limit applies, a Speed Limit sign showing the next speed limit shall be installed." - "If used, the Reduced School Speed Limit Ahead sign shall be followed by a School Speed Limit sign or a School Speed Limit assembly." - "The speed limit displayed on the Reduced School Speed Limit Ahead sign shall be identical to the speed limit displayed on the subsequent School Speed Limit sign or School Speed Limit assembly." Visual evidence: - [Image 1] Figure 7B-2 shows the S1-1 School sign installed in advance of the School Speed Limit assembly (S4-3P/R2-1/S4-1P) at the beginning of the zone, with an END SCHOOL SPEED LIMIT (S5-3) or END SCHOOL ZONE (S5-2) sign, optionally with an R2-1 sign for the next speed limit (45), at the downstream end. - [Image 2] Figure 7B-4 similarly shows the School Speed Limit assembly at the zone beginning, the S4-5 Reduced School Speed Limit Ahead sign and S1-1 sign in advance, and S5-3 or S5-2 signs paired with an optional R2-1 (45) at the downstream end. - [Image 3] Figure 7B-1 illustrates the components involved: the School Speed Limit assembly (S4-3P SCHOOL plaque, R2-1 sign, and a time-period plaque), the S5-1 School Speed Limit When Flashing sign, the S4-5/S4-5a advance signs, and the S5-3 END SCHOOL SPEED LIMIT and S5-2 END SCHOOL ZONE signs. - [Image 4] Page 1019 provides the text of Section 7B.05 Standards §1–§3 governing placement of the assembly, the advance S1-1 sign, and the S5-3 downstream sign, plus the Option (§4) allowing an S5-2 sign instead where the zones end at the same point. - [Image 5] Page 1021 provides Standards §14–§15 on the Reduced School Speed Limit Ahead sign and its required matching speed limit. - [Image 6] Page 1014 shows the Figure 7B-1 sheet identifying the School Speed Limit assembly components and the S5-2/S5-3 end signs. - [Image 7] Page 1013 provides Section 7B.02 context on School (S1-1) sign applications and school zone signing. gold_answer: The assembly or S5-1 sign must be at or as near as practicable to the point where the reduced zone begins. A School (S1-1) sign must be placed in advance of the first school-speed-limit sign in each direction. The downstream end is normally marked with an END SCHOOL SPEED LIMIT (S5-3) sign, with an END SCHOOL ZONE (S5-2) allowed when the two zones end together.
